1.title: Runs per hour
1.description: One server span named POST /invocations per run, service hr_super_agent.DEFAULT, exported by the instrumented container (guppi-gpt's equivalent service was observed in the tenant 5 Sep 2026).

2.title: Run duration p50/p90
2.description: Duration of the POST /invocations server span, which is the whole run rather than the first delta; the first delta lives only on the agent's log line in CloudWatch (runtime-logs), which Firehose does not forward.

3.title: Run outcome split
3.description: The failure flag on the POST /invocations server span. RUN_ERROR events emitted on a 200 stream are not failures here; the outcome field on the agent's CloudWatch log line is the finer source.

4.title: Retrieval rate
4.description: Share of runs (distinct trace ids with a POST /invocations span) whose trace also holds at least one mcp tools/call docs___Retrieve span. Counting spans rather than traces gave more than 100 percent, since one run can call the tool more than once.
4.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == "hr_super_agent.DEFAULT" and (span.name == "POST /invocations" or span.name == "mcp tools/call docs___Retrieve")
| summarize runs = countDistinctExact(if(span.name == "POST /invocations", trace.id)), withRetrieval = countDistinctExact(if(span.name == "mcp tools/call docs___Retrieve", trace.id))
| fields pct = if(runs > 0, withRetrieval * 100.0 / runs, else: 0)

5.title: Token usage
5.description: The Strands model span (named chat <model id>) carries the GenAI semantic convention usage attributes; if the attribute names differ in this Strands version, inspect one chat span in Distributed Tracing and adjust.

6.title: Feedback up/down ratio
6.description: The business event hrsuperagent.reply-feedback, ingested through the EventBridge API destination the stack creates (docs/proposals/feedback.md). The RUM custom action this tile used to query was never stored by the tenant; the vote now arrives on the bizevents table with vote, run.id, and trace.id as top-level fields.

7.title: Routing decisions by area
7.description: Draft (29 Sep 2026), not yet run against the tenant: reads the orchestrator's run log line (domain, confidence, action, delegated_to, confirmed; D26), which reaches Dynatrace only if the runtime's application logs are forwarded.
7.query:
fetch logs
| filter contains(content, "\"delegated_to\"")
| parse content, "JSON:run"
| fieldsAdd area = coalesce(run[delegated_to], run[action])
| summarize turns = count(), by: {area}

8.title: Routing confidence bands
8.description: Draft (29 Sep 2026), not yet run against the tenant: reads the orchestrator's run log line (domain, confidence, action, delegated_to, confirmed; D26), which reaches Dynatrace only if the runtime's application logs are forwarded.
8.query:
fetch logs
| filter contains(content, "\"delegated_to\"")
| parse content, "JSON:run"
| fieldsAdd band = run[confidence]
| summarize turns = count(), by: {band, bin(timestamp, 1h)}

9.title: Confirmed changes and clarifying questions
9.description: Draft (29 Sep 2026), not yet run against the tenant: reads the orchestrator's run log line (domain, confidence, action, delegated_to, confirmed; D26), which reaches Dynatrace only if the runtime's application logs are forwarded.
9.query:
fetch logs
| filter contains(content, "\"delegated_to\"")
| parse content, "JSON:run"
| summarize confirmed = countIf(run[confirmed] == true), clarified = countIf(run[action] == "clarify"), by: {bin(timestamp, 1h)}
